title: Monitors
empty: No monitors yet. Create the first one to start monitoring.
emptyFiltered: No monitors match the current filter.
loadFailed: The monitors could not be loaded.
actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

reached.monitors: Monitor limit reached. Delete a monitor or ask an administrator for a larger plan.
reached.channels: Channel limit reached. Delete a channel or ask an administrator for a larger plan.

exceeded.monitors: More monitors than the plan allows. Existing monitors keep running; new ones are refused.
exceeded.channels: More channels than the plan allows. Existing channels keep running; new ones are refused.
exceeded.interval: Some monitors check more often than the plan allows. They keep running; new or shorter intervals are refused.
